sources.title: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026, Beryllium
sources.facts: 2025 world mine output estimate 430 t Be content; 2024 revised 433 t. 2025 $1600/kg is contained Be in imported 4%-Be copper master alloy, not a pure-metal or sheet quotation.

sources.title: Materion S-200-F structural grade datasheet, 2024-04-09
sources.facts: Bulk VHP grade: typical E 290 GPa, density 1850 kg/m3, CTE 11.3 ppm/K; minimum tensile yield 241 MPa and elongation 2%. Compression minimum is not specified.

sources.title: Materion SR-200 sheet datasheet, 2024-04-09
sources.facts: Typical E 290 GPa, minimum in-plane tensile yield 345 MPa and elongation 10% in 1 inch. Near 0.75 mm, thickness tolerance is +/-0.004 inch; flatness Type 1 2%, Type 2 1%, Type 3 0.030 inch/foot. Measurements may be restrained. Maximum 24x72 inches is listed for >=0.059 inch; 0.020-0.058 inch material is narrower/shorter without dimensions. The parenthetic 0.5 mm conversion for 0.059 inch conflicts with inches. Hot-formed applications are described; no 10 m sphere qualification.

sources.title: Materion, A Guide to Designing and Fabricating with Beryllium, file dated 2020
sources.facts: Cross-rolling balances sheet in-plane properties; wrought texture remains relevant. The guide gives E 303 GPa, whereas 2024 sheets give 290. Page 4 simultaneously describes compression about 10% above tension and prints both S200F yields about 255 MPa, unlike the inherited 283 MPa. Adhesive bonding and brazing are established processes; published average Be lap-shear strengths are not this hull's compression/peel allowables. Aluminium CTE is 22.8 ppm/K versus Be about 11.4. Pages were visually read because this PDF lacks extractable text.

sources.title: 3M AF 163-2 structural adhesive film technical datasheet, November 2009
sources.facts: Nominal films 0.015/0.030/0.045/0.060 lb/ft2 with +/-0.005 tolerance; 0.015 is unsupported, 0.030 has supported and unsupported forms. Intended for solid and honeycomb panels. Be/core performance and required coverage are not qualified here. Film data are representative, not specification allowables.

sources.title: T. L. Stockham, Development of End Fittings for Beryllium Structural Tubing, NASA, 1969
sources.facts: FM1000 double-shear tests used 0.125-inch Be and 0.06-inch steel straps. Unchamfered lap lengths 1-4 inches gave 85-112.5% tensile efficiency; other geometries/adhesives were lower. This is historical evidence that geometry matters, not an allowable for a 0.75 mm pressure-shell seam. Brazed finger-joint development encountered reduced sections and insufficient shear capacity.

sources.title: Dombrowski, Deksnis and Pick, Thermomechanical properties of beryllium, IAEA fusion materials compilation
sources.facts: Measured S200F VHP Poisson ratios span about 0.058-0.108, on machined as-pressed specimens, not rolled sheet. Smooth S200F rotating-beam R=-1, zero mean tests give 262-266 MPa amplitude at 10^7 cycles. The prose's direction ordering is inconsistent; do not use it to assign the better axis. Neither property set establishes bonded SR200 thermal-cycle life.

sources.title: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1024 Beryllium
sources.facts: US industrial reference: 8-hour PEL 0.2 microgram/m3, action level 0.1; 15-minute STEL 2.0. Controls include exposure assessment, engineering/work practices, hygiene, housekeeping and qualifying medical surveillance. Used as a process/cost reference; actual site jurisdiction is unspecified.

joint_assumptions: Own 60/120 mm, one full-gauge Be doubler per skin, one film layer per doubler, gap paste and sealant geometry; inspired by I016, not its SiC mass. Eta is an assumed net-section retention, not a measured thin-shell efficiency. One seam metre includes both skins. Full face-core films counted twice. No stiffness credit for doublers.
